name: 0xf340 game proxy unprotected initVRF
summary: The proxy's initVRF(coordinator, link), which sets the Chainlink VRF v1 coordinator and LINK token, has no access control and can be called again after setup. The attacker set its own contract as coordinator and called the randomness-request function 0x607d60e6 81 times, each paying the 2 LINK fee via transferAndCall to itself, draining 162 LINK; a copycat later re-pointed it, placed a 0.05 ETH game call and answered its own randomness request (0x94985ddd), taking 0.075 ETH and the remaining LINK.
notes: Proxy and implementation 0xd92a9110 are unverified (dormant game contract, last used in January 2022); the mechanism is read from the traces. The Upgraded log at block 13478164 is the last route change, and no call changed the coordinator before the anchor.

Campaign: the proxy's LINK outflows from creation are 2 LINK VRF fees to the real coordinator in 2021, an 8 LINK owner withdrawal in January 2022 (ref tx), the anchor, and 0xce6da995 by c0ffeebabe.eth, whose proceeds went to its own 0x25b71878, not the protocol. Loss is the proxy's LINK and ETH outflow in both.
